_doc: Built-in API client conformance (SPEC §7G.9, §7G.5, §7G.11). A port's harness, per case: starts the fake HTTP server (script[] in order, last repeats; entries {status, body|rawBody|bodyBase64, headers?}), substitutes {server} everywhere (config, args, script bodies and headers, expectations), makes {dir} (passed as gather.dir) and {inputs} (writes inputFiles name->base64 there), sets env and removes unsetEnv, builds the named built-in client (client = a2e|elevenlabs|openai|openrouter|fal) from config, and calls createMedia(client) for verb/args through the function face and then the tool face (fresh script replay, fresh {dir}). Asserts: expectRequests in order (method, path exactly as sent incl. query; body = JSON deep-equal; multipart = parts in order, each {name,value} or {name,filename,contentType,bytesBase64}; headers = subset with exact values; absentHeaders = must not be sent) — when expectRequests is present the request count must match too; expectHeaders on EVERY request; expectProgress; result (files: url/data/type/mimeType exact; saved = file lives directly in {dir}, name matches ^<client>-<verb>-[0-9]+-[0-9]+<ext>$, path absolute, url == 'file://'+path, bytes == bytesBase64) or error (exact) / errorPrefix (startsWith) with status; tool: output exact or outputPattern (regex after substituting {dir} regex-escaped), parts, metadata, noParts = no parts key. liveVerified:false marks a request shape pinned from provider docs, not from a live call. A field absent from a case is not asserted. modelParts (SPEC §7G.6 model visibility): the parts of this tool result that message assembly (§8A) emits to the model — only image parts; video/audio parts stay in RunResult.files and toolCalls[].parts only. Assert with the port's assembly function on a transcript containing this tool result. {inputs} is substituted in expectations too. ctxTimeoutMs (D12): the function face is called with ctx.deadline = now + ctxTimeoutMs (the tool face is not run for such a case); errorPrefix then asserts the message start, maxElapsedMs bounds the call. D9 (SPEC §7G.12): when modelParts is [] the tool-result content the port sends to the model is the plain output string in every message style incl. Anthropic — never an empty content array, never a placeholder; assert it with the same assembly function. D19: a built-in client that does not accept a canonical arg, or lacks a required one, is skipped ⇒ the joined 'media: no client available for …' error naming '<client>: argument "<k>" not supported' / '<client>: missing required argument "<k>"'; a non-canonical key is the plain '<verb>: argument "<k>" not supported'. D20 runFilePath: true ⇒ build RunResult.files from a toolCalls record of this tool result (the port's run-files function) and assert each entry's path equals the corresponding MediaFile.path (absolute, present); false ⇒ no entry has path; parts never hold a path. D21: result.usage exact when present; noUsage:true ⇒ neither the result nor tool metadata has a usage key. D23: expectHeaderPatterns = header name → regex the value must match on EVERY request (start, poll, download).
